architecture-review.json.review: Strict interactive and inherited target protocols share only pure proposal restoration and result validation. An explicit background session wire avoids omitted interactive fields. The existing typed Process step converter is extracted unchanged for both codecs; Process shared identifiers and existing definition JSON remain unchanged. No new project/module dependency, registration, query, host, lock or runtime partial. The cohesive inherited codec's 11-member finding is accepted; existing definition codec size decreases and interactive/result method counts increase for shared overloads. One existing module cycle, five type cycles and 204 existing diagnostics remain; CodeAnalytics still reports blocking errors, while direct scoped Release builds pass.

final-resource-reconciliation.json.outcome: Verified codec candidate: all 124 selected cases pass, including 110 Unit and 14 actual interactive/Process saved-dispatch cases. Both earlier failed runs are retained; all selected cases repeated after the production corrections. Historical cleanup denials remain unchanged.
